title: Talking About Regrets: Wish and If Only
summary: Learn how to use wish and if only to talk about things you want to change. Master expressing regrets about the present and the past.

sections.p: We use wish or if only with the past simple tense to talk about things we want to change now, but cannot. Even though we use a past tense verb, we are talking about the present moment. This is very useful for expressing a strong desire for a different reality today.

ex.en: I wish I had more free time.
ex.mean: I do not have enough free time right now, and I am sad about it.

ex.en: If only I lived closer to the beach.
ex.mean: I live far from the beach now, but I really want to live near it.

ex.en: She wishes she could speak French.
ex.mean: She cannot speak French right now, but she wants to be able to.

sections.p: When we want to talk about mistakes we made in the past, we use wish or if only with the past perfect tense (had + past participle). This structure helps us look back at yesterday or last year and imagine a different result, even though we cannot change history.

ex.en: I wish I had studied harder for the exam.
ex.mean: I did not study hard before, and now I regret my bad grade.

ex.en: If only we had left the house earlier.
ex.mean: We left late, and because of that, we missed our train.

sections.h: Annoying Habits with Could and Would
sections.p: We also use wish or if only with would to complain about someone else's annoying habits or to wish that a situation would change. To talk about our own ability to change something in the future, we use could.

ex.en: I wish you would stop making that loud noise.
ex.mean: You are making a loud noise now, and I want you to stop.

ex.en: If only it would stop raining.
ex.mean: It is raining now, and I want the rain to finish soon.

tip: Remember that for present wishes, you must step one tense back into the past. Think of it as wishing for an alternate reality!

quiz.ask: Choose the correct form for a present wish
quiz.en: I wish I ___ a bigger apartment.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct form for a past regret
quiz.en: If only I ___ my phone at home yesterday.

quiz.ask: Select the best option to complete the sentence
quiz.en: She wishes she ___ drive a car, but she is too young.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct phrase for a complaint about behavior
quiz.en: I wish you ___ leave your muddy shoes by the door.
If only the weather ___ nicer tomorrow.
He wishes he ___ the truth to his parents.
